BLOCKED before driver implementation: no package was authored. This directory holds only the regenerated task card and this record (no driver.py, fake, facts, tests or driver.lock.json). WHAT THE UPSTREAM IS: the PX4 autopilot firmware (C++, with SITL), routed by its flagship override to the planned MAVLink family; the card's entry symbol is the NuttX ymodem file-transfer script (platforms/nuttx/NuttX/apps/system/ymodem/sbrb.py:381), not a vehicle API. WHY NO STOP ROUTE (the MAVLink helper design review, work/handoff-runs/claude-20261104/development/helpers-plr-mav-lerobot/DESIGN-mavlink.md, sections 2-4, re-read against the clone at the pinned commit): every immediate stop stops the motors of a flying vehicle. A forced disarm (param2 21196) disarms in flight (src/modules/commander/Commander.cpp:1110-1121); flight termination switches to NAVIGATION_STATE_TERMINATION (Commander.cpp:1135-1150), whose actuator output is 'failsafe (by default same as disarmed)' (msg/ActuatorArmed.msg:8), and the termination switch 'cannot be undone' (msg/ManualControlSwitches.msg:26). Mode requests (LAND, RTL, BRAKE, HOLD) are answered by COMMAND_ACK, whose ACCEPTED means accepted, not achieved; landing takes seconds to minutes, beyond the e-stop budget of SAFE-040. A mobile or flying vehicle is R2 under the hazard table (MHS/spec/04-safety.md); the user decided on 2026-11-04 that actuators without a source-backed stop stay blocked, and an earlier model review blocked an ArduPilot package because a LAND acknowledgement is not safe cessation (MHS/drivers/robots/sidharthmohannair__ros2-ardupilot-sitl-hardware/RESULT.json). A telemetry-only package would replace the vehicle's primary control with observation, which MHS/handoff/PROMPT.md step 1 forbids. WHAT WOULD UNBLOCK IT: a user e-stop policy per airframe class (whether a forced disarm or flight termination may ever be an e-stop, for example on a tethered or caged test stand); an override that names a concrete vehicle class and interface instead of the card's entry symbols; a finite profile for ground vehicles (HOLD with sensed confirmation of the mode and of a ground speed below an operator-required bound within the budget, plus an independent RC or hardware kill that a human cites as estop_physical_ref); then a reviewed MAVLink helper with a SITL transcript fake. Only the missing-layout diagnostic gate ran (the gate fields below); no upstream code, simulator, connection or device ran, and no hardware run or human review is claimed.
